page_title: MCI 2-0 EVE | Manchester City v Everton 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' What a sweet touch by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Jordan Pickford to hold.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyler Dibling (Everton) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+5' Manchester City slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90+5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Phil Foden (Manchester City).
90+3' Phil Foden (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+2' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+2' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
89' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:1.
86' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tyler Dibling (Everton) for Iliman Ndiaye.
86' The substitution is prepared. Dwight McNeil (Everton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall.
86' Substitution. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has come on for Nico.
85' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) replacing Savinho.
85' Substitution. Rico Lewis (Manchester City) replaces Nico O'Reilly.
84' Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' Jake O'Brien (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
82' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
81' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.

80' Manchester City hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

77' Iliman Ndiaye dinks a cheeky lofted pass into Merlin Rohl (Everton), but his headed effort from near the penalty spot goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Thierno Barry (Everton) is replacing Beto.
74' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
73' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.
73' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
72' Savinho (Manchester City) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Erling Haaland, but Jordan Pickford displays great awareness to stop him.
70' Substitution. Merlin Rohl (Everton) on for Carlos Alcaraz.
70' David Moyes has decided to substitute Idrissa Gueye and he is replaced by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton).

70' Phil Foden (Manchester City) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
69' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
68' Rough tackle by Michael Keane (Everton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Manchester City.
67' Tony Harrington blows his whistle. James Garner (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
65' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) plays a lovely through ball to Erling Haaland, but he can't beat Jordan Pickford and loses the ball.

63' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Savinho slips the ball through to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent low shot into the back of the net. He makes it 2:0.
62' James Garner (Everton) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is well positioned and punches the ball away.
61' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) tries to find Beto, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
59' Here is a change. Tijjani Reijnders is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) coming on for Jeremy Doku.

58' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Nico O'Reilly beats his man and slings in a cross towards Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who evades his marker and plants a fine header low into the middle of the net from close in. 1:0.
57' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
55' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.
53' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call.
52' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
50' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

50' Everton players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester City.
48' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and it's Beto (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Tony Harrington has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The referee awards a corner and Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take it.
45+3' A great solo run by Savinho (Manchester City) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom right corner was easily caught by Jordan Pickford.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
45' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
43' Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Great chance! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
41' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City).

41' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) unleashes a promising shot towards the top right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Gianluigi Donnarumma thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
39' James Garner (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
37' Everton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
34' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner.
33' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Phil Foden (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

31' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
26' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 66:34.

24' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the set piece. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and crashes against the crossbar.
24' Phil Foden (Manchester City) steps up to send the ball in.
24' Savinho (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Manchester City are seeing far more of the ball now.
18' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

16' That was close by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
16' Manchester City string together a series of short passes.

16' Savinho (Manchester City) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Jordan Pickford guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

14' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City. Gianluigi Donnarumma doesn't have to worry about this one. Iliman Ndiaye plays a pass into the feet of Beto (Everton), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
13' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find Jeremy Doku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

11' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
10' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will take a corner kick.
9' A long ball forward to Phil Foden (Manchester City) is intercepted.
8' Manchester City are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
6' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' It looks like Idrissa Gueye (Everton) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
4' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
